feature: Four AMJ Environment wetland-native plants (Yoshi, Suge, Hannoki, Mizugoke)
scope: DLC-free standalone naturally generated Japanese wetlands with four Environment-owned PlantDefs. Suge may yield existing Vanilla Hay with optional MO Hay-to-Straw processing (approved integration; yield unapproved); Mizugoke is selectable and cuttable, non-harvestable and non-sowable. No new material ThingDefs or independent crafting/medicine subsystem. Other Mods remain optional coexistence targets.

search.limitations: Bounded source comparison, not exhaustive Workshop search. Odyssey is not owned or runtime-tested by the author. No mixed installed-MO/VE/Biomes!/ReGrowth loaded-Def test yet; actual load-order conflicts and optional coexistence behavior remain separate post-implementation gates. Japanese descriptions and source art still require author approval. Evidence document records pinned XML and uncertainty; the formal ready state authorizes the independent-implementation scope, not art publication or runtime acceptance.

candidates.name: Vanilla generic wetland plants and Odyssey DLC Reeds/Bulrush

comparison.function: Vanilla TallGrass/Moss/Willow are generic proxies. Odyssey adds Reeds/Bulrush, but only when DLC is active.
comparison.historical_fit: Generic proxies cannot distinctly depict all four historical Japanese wetland roles; Bulrush is not sedge.
comparison.dependencies: Vanilla baseline exists; Odyssey is an unavailable optional DLC.
comparison.retention: Preserve Vanilla baseline behavior and the existing Healroot supply; do not convert to Odyssey-dependent content.
comparison.progression_balance: Add one species at a time; preserve approved wetland plant-weight totals and woody proportions.
comparison.reuse: Reuse gameplay's standard plant Def and biome mechanisms, not the optional Odyssey species as mandatory prerequisites.
comparison.maintenance_license: No DLC XML or assets are copied; Odyssey runtime compatibility is unverified.

candidates.name: Medieval Overhaul Dark Forest Odyssey-conditional water plants

comparison.function: MO references Reeds/Bulrush under MayRequire Odyssey in Dark Forest, not an independent source of all four plants.
comparison.historical_fit: The Dark Forest pool is not a sufficient replacement for AMJE's two natural Japanese wetland biomes.
comparison.dependencies: MO and its Odyssey-gated entries are optional and must not be added as AMJE baseline dependencies.
comparison.retention: Keep MO useful content intact; avoid forcing it into standalone Environment.
comparison.progression_balance: Check optional overlap without changing AMJE's fundamental vegetation balance.
comparison.reuse: Reference optional compatibility and Patch load order only; avoid copying MO definitions.
comparison.maintenance_license: The archive was statically inspected; no MO/Odyssey loaded-Def test was claimed.

candidates.name: AMJ Environment four-plant natural vegetation responsibility

comparison.function: Owner of AMJE biome, climate, wild plant placement and the four proposed native plant Defs.
comparison.historical_fit: Full wetland vegetation must be coherent for medieval Japan without optional external Mods.
comparison.dependencies: Only RimWorld/Harmony baseline; no MO, VE, Biomes! or Odyssey requirement.
comparison.retention: Retain AMJE current approved wetland ecosystems, wildlife, diseases and Healroot while adding species.
comparison.progression_balance: Keep 7.30/8.22 total and 3.00/1.80 woody commonality unless separately approved after review.
comparison.reuse: Use Environment-owned XML/graphics and existing plant generation machinery; optional coexistence patches only if tested.
comparison.maintenance_license: New graphics and historical descriptions require author acceptance; no third-party source assets copied.

comparison.function: Cultivated farms and fruit trees; no inspected natural wetland quartet.
comparison.historical_fit: Cultivated non-Japanese-specific species do not reconstruct wild Japanese marsh and peat-bog composition.
comparison.dependencies: A content Mod dependency would replace neither Environment's four plant roles nor its world/biome ownership.
comparison.retention: Leave VPE crops and fruit trees unchanged if installed.
comparison.progression_balance: Optional co-existence must not change AMJE wild wetland totals or add duplicate populations.
comparison.reuse: Study farming plant patterns only if useful; not a natural Japanese wetland replacement.
comparison.maintenance_license: No VPE XML or assets reused; inspect pinned source for compatible behavior.

comparison.function: Watercress/Lotus/WaterChestnut are cultivated; no direct inspected wild wetland quartet.
comparison.historical_fit: Aquatic cultivation and spontaneous forest/swamp ecology are distinct activities.
comparison.dependencies: Additional VE module is optional and not needed by the standalone environment.
comparison.retention: Do not suppress More Plants' cultivated content.
comparison.progression_balance: Wild-pool adjustments must not interfere with cultivated plant progression.
comparison.reuse: Potential compatibility for map presence only; do not share as a required plant provider.
comparison.maintenance_license: No external definitions or images copied.

candidates.name: Biomes! Prehistoric Sedge, Red Sphagnum and Bog Moss

comparison.function: Contains BMT_Sedge, BMT_RedSphagnum and BMT_BogMoss with Biomes! Core plant-control extension and Vanilla wetland additive patches.
comparison.historical_fit: Overlaps the sedge/moss roles but provides a broader prehistoric biome ecosystem rather than an integrated Japan-native set.
comparison.dependencies: Biomes! Core and a large prehistoric dinosaur/vegetation pack are not acceptable mandatory dependencies just for these plants.
comparison.retention: Retain full third-party prehistoric content if installed; never strip it to extract three plant assets.
comparison.progression_balance: Its ColdBog PatchOperationAdd may be overridden by AMJE whole-pool replacement or alter totals in the reverse order; test both paths.
comparison.reuse: Treat source as prior art and consider a separately gated conditional compatibility patch to balance coexistence, not basic AMJE species replacement.
comparison.maintenance_license: Third-party CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus its custom Def classes require independent original XML/assets; do not copy.

comparison.function: Wild Swamp defines White Willow and fantasy-plant variants but not the four native Japanese wetland species.
comparison.historical_fit: White Willow is not Hannoki (Alnus); decorative swamp plants do not substitute natural Japanese wetland structure.
comparison.dependencies: ReGrowth 2 is not required for AMJE.
comparison.retention: Keep existing ReGrowth biome/plant features if installed.
comparison.progression_balance: Its whole-pool and conditional DLC patch paths need final loaded-Def conflict checks.
comparison.reuse: Prior art and optional coexistence, not a mandatory source of species.
comparison.maintenance_license: Upstream compatibility untested at runtime; no external art or XML copied.

decision.rationale: The author's explicit 2026-10-09 standalone-environment requirement means AMJE must itself supply Yoshi, Suge, Hannoki and Mizugoke. Vanilla proxies cannot distinguish their natural ecological roles; Odyssey is optional and unowned, VE focuses on cultivation, Biomes! Prehistoric adds a broad dependent prehistoric ecosystem, and ReGrowth does not supply an equivalent Japanese four-species set. The external Mods are investigated for optional coexistence only; an existing similar species never cancels Environment-owned scope.
decision.independent_gap: Standalone Japanese wetland-native vegetation in TemperateSwamp and ColdBog, depicting reeds, sedges, alder wetlands and sphagnum peat bogs without requiring Odyssey, Biomes!, ReGrowth or VE.
